allow: Bash(then echo "✓ Basic theme functionality implemented in app.js" else echo "✗ Basic theme functionality missing" fi)
Bash(echo "✓ No major style references found" echo echo "3. File status check:" if [ ! -f "public/js/styleSettingsManager.js" ])
Bash(then echo "✓ styleSettingsManager.js - DELETED" else echo "✗ styleSettingsManager.js - STILL PRESENT" fi if [ ! -f "public/css/features/style-settings.css" ])

Bash(then echo "✓ style-settings.css - DELETED" else echo "✗ style-settings.css - STILL PRESENT" fi echo echo "4. Theme functionality verification:" grep -q "basic.*theme\|dark.*theme\|initializeBasicTheme" public/js/app.js)
